meta.name: PC Diagnostic Atlas
meta.method: Taxonomy and diagnostic flows extracted from six uploaded DOCX source documents. Missing standalone flows are marked catalog-only rather than invented.

layers.name: POWER
layers.description: External AC/DC power, charger/PSU, battery, charging port and power-button path before motherboard power-rail diagnosis.
layers.boundary: If input power reaches the motherboard but the machine remains dead, continue to Layer 2.

layers.name: MOTHERBOARD / POWER RAILS
layers.description: Motherboard input circuits, standby rails, regulators/VRM, MOSFETs, filtering, sequencing, clocks, reset and PWRGOOD.
layers.boundary: When major rails, clock, reset and PWRGOOD are valid but POST still does not begin, continue to Layer 3/4.

layers.name: CORE HARDWARE
layers.description: CPU, RAM, GPU and cooling hardware after the board power sequence is reasonably proven.
layers.boundary: Hardware faults remain here; firmware initialization/compatibility issues move to Layer 4.

layers.name: POST / BIOS / UEFI
layers.description: Firmware execution, POST, CMOS/RTC, hardware initialization, UEFI boot configuration and handoff toward the bootloader.
layers.boundary: Once firmware selects the correct boot path and the OS bootloader is reached, continue to Layer 5.

layers.name: STORAGE / BOOT
layers.description: Storage device/interface, partition table, EFI System Partition, boot files, BCD/bootloader and Windows Boot Manager.
layers.boundary: If the OS loader starts and the failure occurs during OS startup, continue to Layer 6.

layers.name: OS / DRIVER / SOFTWARE
layers.description: Operating system, drivers, device firmware, services, filesystems, applications, security software and system configuration.
layers.boundary: This layer begins after power, POST, storage and bootloader stages are reasonably proven.

flows.title: Máy hoàn toàn không có nguồn
flows.symptomDescription: Symptom → Press Power → No LED → No fan → No charging LED → No sound
flows.hypothesis: Wall outlet / power strip has no AC power
flows.test: Connect charger/PC directly to a known-good wall outlet
flows.yesOutcome: Narrow down → Original outlet / → power strip faulty → Find cause → Repair / replace outlet, → strip or connection
flows.noOutcome: New hypothesis → Cable / charger / → PSU faulty
flows.notes: Dell và Lenovo đều khuyến nghị bỏ qua UPS/power strip và kiểm tra trực tiếp bằng một ổ điện đã biết hoạt động trước khi đi sâu hơn.
references: Nguồn: Dell — Troubleshoot PSU/No Power; Lenovo — No power or system does not run on battery power.
rawFlow: Wall outlet / power strip has no AC power

flows.title: Mất nguồn hoặc chập chờn liên quan dây nguồn
flows.symptomDescription: Symptom → No power → OR → Power comes and goes → OR → Adapter LED changes when cable is moved
flows.hypothesis: AC power cable damaged or loose
flows.test: Replace ONLY the AC cable with a known-good compatible cable
flows.yesOutcome: Cable isolated → as fault → Replace cable
flows.noOutcome: New hypothesis → Adapter / PSU
flows.notes: Dell và Lenovo đều đưa việc kiểm tra kết nối, hư hỏng vật lý và thử dây khác vào quy trình chẩn đoán nguồn.
references: Nguồn: Dell — How to Troubleshoot AC Adapter Issues; Lenovo — Troubleshooting No Power Issues.
rawFlow: AC power cable damaged or loose

flows.title: LED trên charger không sáng
flows.symptomDescription: Symptom → Charger connected to wall → Charger LED OFF → Laptop no charge / no power
flows.hypothesis: Adapter itself is faulty
flows.test: Use known-good compatible adapter
flows.yesOutcome: Adapter fault → confirmed → Replace adapter
flows.noOutcome: New hypothesis → DC jack / laptop
flows.notes: Dell hướng dẫn rằng nếu adapter LED vẫn không sáng sau khi reseat nguồn, adapter là một nghi phạm chính; thử adapter tương thích đã biết tốt là cách cô lập phù hợp.
references: Nguồn: Dell — Computer Won't Turn On và Troubleshoot AC Adapter Issues.

flows.title: Charger LED sáng bình thường, cắm vào laptop thì tắt
flows.sourceSection: 4. ADAPTER LED TẮT KHI CẮM VÀO LAPTOP
flows.symptomDescription: Adapter disconnected from laptop → LED = ON → Connect adapter to laptop → LED = OFF
flows.symptom: Adapter LED shuts off when connected
flows.hypothesis: Laptop input has excessive load / short
flows.test: Try another known-good correct adapter
flows.yesOutcome: Narrow down → fault inside laptop → DC jack → Power-input circuit → Motherboard → Find cause → Repair
flows.noOutcome: Original → adapter faulty
flows.notes: Nếu nhiều adapter tốt đều bị ngắt khi kết nối vào laptop, điều này hỗ trợ mạnh giả thuyết có sự cố phía laptop; bước tiếp theo thường là DC jack → power-input circuitry → motherboard. Tuy nhiên, đây chưa tự động chứng minh motherboard hỏng.
references: Nguồn: Dell — Laptop Battery Not Charging: Resolve AC Adapter Issues và các hướng dẫn chẩn đoán Dell về adapter LED.
rawFlow: Laptop input has excessive load / short

flows.title: Laptop chạy bằng adapter nhưng pin không sạc
flows.symptomDescription: Symptom → Laptop ON with charger → Battery: → "Plugged in, not charging" → or charge stays very low
flows.hypothesis: Battery has degraded / failed
flows.test: Run manufacturer battery diagnostic
flows.yesOutcome: Battery fault → Replace battery → DC jack → Charging circuit
flows.noOutcome: New hypothesis → Adapter recognition
flows.notes: HP khuyến nghị hard reset rồi dùng HP Battery Check để xác định tình trạng pin; nếu pin pass thì cần tiếp tục kiểm tra adapter và hệ thống charging thay vì thay pin theo phỏng đoán.
references: Nguồn: HP — HP Battery Check: Fix laptop battery not charging.

flows.title: Máy chạy bằng adapter nhưng tắt ngay khi rút adapter
flows.symptomDescription: AC connected → Laptop works → AC removed → Laptop immediately shuts down
flows.hypothesis: Battery cannot supply power
flows.test: Run battery health diagnostic
flows.yesOutcome: Battery faulty → Replace
flows.noOutcome: New hypothesis → Battery connector / → charging system
flows.verify: Boot and operate on battery only
flows.notes: HP mô tả trường hợp laptop không hoạt động khi unplugged như một dấu hiệu cần kiểm tra battery health trước khi quyết định thay pin.
rawFlow: Boot and operate on battery only

flows.title: Chỉ sạc khi giữ đầu charger ở một góc nhất định
flows.symptomDescription: Đây là symptom rất điển hình của lỗi cơ khí ở connector. → Normal position → Not charging → Move connector slightly → Charging → Release → Stops charging
flows.hypothesis: DC jack / connector mechanically damaged
flows.test: Use known-good adapter and check connector fit
flows.yesOutcome: DC jack suspect → Inspect jack → Loose / cracked / → damaged connector → Repair / replace jack
flows.noOutcome: Original adapter → connector suspect
flows.notes: Một connector lỏng có thể tạo symptom sạc chỉ ở một số vị trí; nhưng cần loại trừ đầu cắm của adapter trước khi kết luận DC jack hỏng. Dell cũng liệt kê charging port, adapter và cable là các nguyên nhân riêng biệt cần cô lập.
references: Nguồn: Dell — Troubleshoot AC Adapter Issues và Dell support cases về loose charging connection.

flows.title: KNOWN-GOOD ADAPTER NHƯNG LAPTOP VẪN KHÔNG NHẬN NGUỒN
flows.sourceSection: 8. KNOWN-GOOD ADAPTER NHƯNG LAPTOP VẪN KHÔNG NHẬN NGUỒN
flows.symptomDescription: Known-good charger → Correct voltage / wattage → Laptop still has no charge LED / no power
flows.symptom: Known-good adapter but no input power
flows.hypothesis: DC jack is not passing power
flows.test: Measure/check DC input at jack output / board connector
flows.yesOutcome: Move hypothesis → to Layer 2 → motherboard → power circuit
flows.noOutcome: DC jack / cable → fault → Repair jack
flows.verify: Stable input voltage Adapter output good + DC voltage reaches motherboard + Machine still dead  STOP Layer 1  Go to Layer 2 Motherboard / Power Rails
flows.notes: Đây là ranh giới quan trọng: Nếu nguồn đã thực sự tới motherboard nhưng máy vẫn chết, việc tiếp tục gọi đó là “charger problem” là sai hướng; lúc này cần chuyển sang circuit/power-rail diagnosis. Dell cũng phân biệt adapter, charging port và charging circuit thành các nhóm lỗi khác nhau. Lưu ý: Với USB-C Power Delivery, quy trình phức tạp hơn barrel-jack thông thường vì còn quá trình USB-PD negotiation; không nên suy luận chỉ từ việc “đo thấy 5 V”.
rawFlow: DC jack is not passing power

flows.title: DESKTOP PSU — COMPLETELY DEAD
flows.symptomDescription: Symptom → Press Power → No fan → No motherboard LED → No activity
flows.hypothesis: PSU is not supplying power
flows.test: Run PSU BIST (if PSU supports BIST)
flows.yesOutcome: New hypothesis → power button / → motherboard
flows.noOutcome: PSU suspect → Replace PSU
flows.notes: Dell dùng PSU Built-In Self-Test (BIST) để tách lỗi PSU khỏi các phần còn lại trên các desktop hỗ trợ tính năng này.
references: Nguồn: Dell — How to Run a Power Supply Unit Self-Test và How to Troubleshoot the PSU.

flows.title: DESKTOP BẬT LÊN RỒI TẮT
flows.symptomDescription: Press Power → Fan spins → 1–3 seconds → System shuts down
flows.hypothesis: PSU protection trips / PSU cannot maintain output
flows.test: Substitute known-good adequately-rated PSU
flows.yesOutcome: PSU fault likely → Replace PSU → Layer 2
flows.noOutcome: New hypothesis → motherboard short / → CPU power /
flows.notes: PSUs có các protection mechanisms như over-current, short-circuit, under/over-voltage và overload protection có thể làm PSU shutdown khi phát hiện tình trạng bất thường. Vì vậy “bật rồi tắt” không tự động chứng minh PSU hỏng — short trên motherboard cũng có thể kích hoạt protection.
references: Nguồn: Seasonic — PSU protection mechanisms; Dell PSU troubleshooting.

flows.title: RANDOM SHUTDOWN / RESTART UNDER LOAD
flows.symptomDescription: Idle → works → Gaming / rendering / heavy load → sudden shutdown/restart
flows.hypothesis: PSU cannot maintain required power
flows.test: Substitute known-good adequately-rated PSU
flows.yesOutcome: PSU isolated → Replace PSU → motherboard
flows.noOutcome: New hypothesis → thermal / → GPU / CPU /
references: Nguồn không ổn định hoặc protection kích hoạt dưới tải có thể gây shutdown/restart, nhưng thermal problems và các component khác cũng tạo symptom tương tự. Do đó chỉ thay PSU thử mới giúp cô lập giả thuyết này tốt hơn.
Nguồn: Seasonic — PSU selection, protection and load testing.

flows.title: Bấm nút Power không phản ứng
flows.symptomDescription: Đặc biệt hữu ích trên desktop. → AC power good → PSU appears good → Motherboard standby power present → Press button → Nothing
flows.hypothesis: Case power switch / PWR_SW cable faulty
flows.test: Momentarily bridge the two PWR_SW header pins
flows.yesOutcome: Power button / → cable faulty → Repair button → or cable
flows.noOutcome: New hypothesis → PSU / motherboard → Layer 2
flows.notes: Intel hướng dẫn rằng momentarily bridging đúng power-switch header pins thực hiện cùng chức năng với việc nhấn nút power và là cách hữu ích để loại trừ case switch. Phải xác định đúng pins từ motherboard manual trước khi làm.
references: Nguồn: Intel — Troubleshooting: Why Won't My Computer Turn On?

flows.title: Input power is present, but motherboard is completely dead
flows.symptomDescription: Known-good adapter / PSU → Input voltage reaches motherboard → Press Power → No fan → No LEDs → No POST activity
flows.hypothesis: Required standby / always-on rail is missing
flows.test: Measure one known standby rail using the schematic/reference board
flows.yesOutcome: New hypothesis → Power sequence / → EC / reset problem → Continue sequence → Find cause → Repair
flows.noOutcome: Narrow down → Standby regulator / → input circuit → Find failed stage → Repair → Verify standby rail
flows.notes: This is the correct transition from Layer 1: once external input power is known to reach the board, the problem becomes motherboard power generation or sequencing rather than charger/PSU diagnosis. Dell also separates No Power from No POST and provides motherboard-oriented diagnostics such as M-BIST on supported systems.
references: References: Dell — Troubleshoot Power Issues on a Dell Laptop; Dell — Resolve No Power, No POST, No Boot or No Video Issues.
rawFlow: Required standby / always-on rail is missing

flows.title: BOARD STARTS AND IMMEDIATELY SHUTS DOWN
flows.sourceSection: 2. BOARD STARTS AND IMMEDIATELY SHUTS DOWN
flows.symptomDescription: Press Power → LED / fan activates → 1–5 seconds → Motherboard shuts down
flows.hypothesis: A required rail fails during power sequencing
flows.test: Monitor ONE suspect rail while pressing Power
flows.observe: Does the rail appear then collapse?
flows.yesOutcome: Narrow down → Rail regulator / → over-current / load → Find cause → Repair
flows.noOutcome: New hypothesis → Next rail / → reset / clock
flows.notes: Power-up sequencing matters because processors and other devices expect supplies and control signals to become valid in the proper sequence. Intel's VRD documentation explicitly requires defined processor power sequencing.
references: Reference: Intel — Voltage Regulator-Down (VRD) Design Guidelines.
rawFlow: Does the rail appear then collapse?

flows.title: Adapter voltage reaches the jack, but not the main motherboard rail
flows.symptomDescription: Adapter output = correct → DC jack input = correct → Voltage after input protection stage = missing
flows.symptom: Input voltage enters board but does not pass input circuit
flows.hypothesis: Input MOSFET / fuse / protection element is not conducting
flows.test: Measure voltage immediately before and after ONE input element
flows.observe: Voltage before = present Voltage after = absent?
flows.yesOutcome: Narrow down → That stage is suspect → Find cause → Repair failed element → or its control circuit
flows.noOutcome: New hypothesis → Move downstream
flows.notes: The key is not to immediately declare the MOSFET defective. A good MOSFET may remain off because its gate-drive or protection controller is intentionally preventing conduction.
